captureNotes: No remote run was dispatched, retried or cancelled; these were the already-authorized main push runs.
Initial gh raw-log reads rejected terminal escapes locally. A read-only retry with --allow-escape-sequences preserved the original bytes; this was not a CI retry or build failure.
Original GET API responses remain in cache and are referenced by hash. The public API summary includes selected non-email fields only.
boundaries: This is not future tag CI and does not verify publishing or anonymous downloads.
The GitLab pipeline failed before starting jobs due to quota. It provides no compilation or runtime success evidence.
No dedicated server, rendered GUI client, performance, Anti-Xray or real hardware/VM acceptance is inferred from this CI.
The 14 modern and 8 legacy CI artifact names are source-build outputs; they neither replace nor assert byte identity with the separately frozen local/published JARs.
Forge 1.20.6 is not in the committed modern target tuple. Its later development is excluded.
Bare Gradle test/check tasks, NO-SOURCE and lifecycle UP-TO-DATE states are not counted as fresh test cases; the one Python skip is preserved.
